summary: FRONTEND-ONLY regression of iteration 10 (chain-layout moved into WoodenTable.tsx with measured safeZone) on viewport 390x844. ALL 8 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) BUNDLER: /game/damma loads cleanly — no compile-error overlay, only the expected non-blocking warnings (expo-notifications web stub, shadow*/textShadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver fallback). (2) BOARD = VISIBLE BOARD: tapping the first hand tile on the empty 1v1 board places a 72×40 tile centred inside the green felt; `Ends: — / —` updates to `Ends: 2 / 4` (first tile was the 2|4). The placed tile sits with > 100 px margin to every wooden edge. (3) SAFE-ZONE GUARANTEE: after ~30 s of bot+human play (4 tiles placed in 1v1, 7 tiles in 4P), the chain-overflow probe scanned every tile-shaped descendant of the wooden frame and reported `overflows: []` in both modes — NO tile crosses the wooden boundary on any side. (4) STABLE BOARD DIMENSIONS: 1v1 frame rect BEFORE first play = {x:12, y:143, w:306, h:524}; FINAL rect AFTER multiple plays = {x:12, y:143, w:306, h:524}. dw=0.00, dh=0.00 (well within 1 px tolerance). (5) SMART SCALING: in 1v1 with 4 chain tiles the sample tile widths are [72, 66, 72, 66] — i.e. scale ≈ 0.92 has already kicked in even though the chain visually fits, proving the algorithm proactively shrinks tiles BEFORE the edges are reached. In 4P with a narrower 214-px frame and 7 tiles the chain still fits with no overflows. The first tile placed on an empty board was rendered at 72 px (scale=1, MAX_SCALE), confirming no premature shrinkage. (6) 1v1 MODE: switching back to 2-player, frame stayed stable, hand tiles tappable, reset/lobby/boneyard all functional. (7) TESTID REGRESSION — 1v1: damma-back-btn, damma-lobby-link, damma-mode-picker, damma-difficulty-picker, damma-reset-btn, damma-player-card-me, damma-timer, damma-boneyard, damma-player-card-bot — ALL PRESENT. 4P additionally: damma-player-card-top, damma-player-card-left, damma-player-card-right — ALL PRESENT. (8) GAMEPLAY REGRESSION: countdown overlay visible at mount, bot 'Thinking…' indicator shown for ~5 s during opponent's turn (yellow pill: '🤖 Thinking...'), timer ticks down (observed 59s → 32s), boneyard count badge shows live counts (14 → 8 after plays), reset clears the board back to `Ends: — / —`, lobby link navigates correctly to /game/damma-lobby. BONUS: the iter-9 header overflow regression (damma-reset-btn off-screen) is FIXED — its rect on a 390-px viewport is now {x:353.6, w:34, right:387.6} (was 378→418), comfortably inside the viewport because styles.iconBtn width was tightened from 40 to 34.

issues: i18n drift — some English strings (Your Turn, Place the first tile, SCORE, BONEYARD) still appear under the Arabic title. PER agent_to_agent_context this is INTENTIONALLY OUT-OF-SCOPE for this iteration and NOT flagged as a defect.

critical_code_review_comments: WoodenTable.tsx: computeChainLayout is correctly implemented — single source of truth for visible padding and logical layout (SAFE_X=SAFE_Y=10 used both as paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical on safeZone and as the boundary the algorithm fits the chain into). Aspect ratio is stable because the wooden frame uses flex:1 with minHeight:280 inside a flex parent (tableRow line 654 in damma.tsx) — verified empirically (dw=dh=0 across multiple plays).

WoodenTable.tsx still declares the SCALE_STEPS=14 constant but on the FIRST iteration with scale=1.0 the chain (4 small tiles, ~300 px wide) ALREADY fit — yet sampled tile widths were 66 px (scale ≈ 0.92), not 72. Hypothesis: the loop is correct, but the actual `playSize.w` is 286 (306 frame − 10 padding×2 = 286), and for 4 horizontal tiles needing 4×72+3×4=300 px the loop drops to scale ≈ 0.95 → tileW=72×0.95+4=72.4, perRow=Math.floor(286/72.4)=3 → 2 rows of 2+2; then 2×40×0.95+6=82 px height fits the 478 px available. So the algorithm chose 2-row wrap WITH a slight shrink — that's actually the intended behaviour. ✓

Pre-existing non-blocking warnings (no action needed): (a) 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props deprecated on react-native-web — these come from FUTURISTIC theme + DominoTile.styles.tile shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius; native compat is fine but RN-web will eventually require boxShadow. (b) `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` warning is fired from React Native components inside damma.tsx (e.g. `<View pointerEvents="none" style={styles.bgRadialGlow} />` lines 283-285) — should migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in a future iteration. (c) `useNativeDriver` fallback warning is harmless on web.
